mapper.select: select child.id, child.code, child.name, child.description, child.name_en, child.description_en, parent.code as parent_code, parent.name as parent_name, parent.name_en as parent_name_en from error_types child inner join error_types parent on parent.id = child.parent_id where child.type_level = 2 and child.enabled = true and child.deleted = false and parent.type_level = 1 and parent.enabled = true and parent.deleted = false order by parent.sort_order, child.sort_order, child.id

select id, parent_id, type_level, code, name, description, name_en, description_en, sort_order, enabled, deleted, created_at, updated_at from error_types where id = #{id} and type_level = 2 and enabled = true and deleted = false

select id, parent_id, type_level, code, name, description, name_en, description_en, sort_order, enabled, deleted, created_at, updated_at from error_types where code = #{code} and type_level = 2 and enabled = true and deleted = false
